title: Al-Infitar 82:1-4 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Summer 1: Al-Infitar, ghunnah and the sifat in practice
source: Written for quran/y6 lesson 30 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Infitar 82:1-4 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 30. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتْ (١) وَإِذَا ٱلْكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتْ (٢) وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ (٣) وَإِذَا ٱلْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ (٤)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: And when the stars fall, scattering,
And when the seas are erupted
And when the [contents of] graves are scattered,

head: Word
Where
Rule
How to read it
rows: ث whispered (hams), ر heavy then light

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Infitar 82:1-4 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 82:1-4 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 82:1-4 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: List the four events in 82:1 to 4.
questions.a: The sky breaks apart; the stars scatter; the seas burst; the graves are overturned.

questions.q: Which letter in «ٱنتَثَرَتْ» is whispered (hams), and how do you show it?
questions.a: ت and ث are hams letters: let the breath flow.

questions.q: What happens to the seas in 82:3?
options: They are made to burst forth
questions.a: A) They are made to burst forth. 82:3: 'And when the seas are erupted.'

questions.q: Al-Infitar 82:1: «إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: Al-Infitar begins with the sky splitting and the stars scattering. Why do you think the Qur'an describes the end of the world so vividly?
questions.a: So that we wake up and prepare: what seems permanent will end, and only our deeds remain.
